title: Riot X Nic Salts Sweet Mint 10ml E-Liquid
description: Sweet Mint from the Riot X collection is a refreshingly sophisticated take on a classic mint flavour. It packs all the brisk, bracing ice notes familiar to fans of pure Menthol e-liquids, but adds a fabulously fresh, authentically herbal layer shot through with a delicate sweetness that makes this an endlessly satisfying choice for an all-day vape. The Riot X collection continues Riot Squad’s mastery of Bar Salts, a category of e-liquids that offer more intense, double-concentrated flavours that expertly mimic those found in the most popular single-use disposables. Since they’re available in handy 10ml bottles, they’re an ideal choice for anyone switching from disposable vapes to reusable MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape devices, providing the same bold, intense flavours they’re used to alongside the benefits and cost-savings that such e-liquids and devices offer. Riot Squad’s Riot X Salt E-Liquids are formulated with Hybrid Nicotine, an innovative blend of traditional freebase nicotine and nicotine salts. The combination of the freebase with nic salts, as well as its 50PG/50VG ratio, results in an exceptionally well-balanced vape experience where neither the quality of the flavour, throat hit, or vapour production falls behind the others. Please note: this flavour profile may contain hints of 'ice'.
